d: The historically rich land of Bihar has a diverse cuisine with plethora of delicacies. The scrumptious and unique Bihari dishes are a treat for foodies who love to explore local flavours. Fascinated by the enticing food stories from the state, we had set out to explore its vibrant foodscape beyond litti chokha. So here we are ready with an amusing food series that brings you the gastronomic details from different parts of the state. It isn't just a journey of taste but an expedition to collate stories - stories that delights, stories that informs and stories that inspire. So get ready for…
